mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for 3 months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below 101.5 and 1300 respectively indicates weakening economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth falters.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 101.5 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 100), reduced output signals declining corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month increases equity valuation multiples, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% and persists for 3 months, it indicates labor market slack that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) below 23380 and 1300 respectively signals broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 23380 and HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 315.0, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315.0.
